OnTurnEndInHand.issue: Closed 2026-07-29 (round 7): Debt costs gold now. Debt.cs:26-30 is `Mathf.Min(DynamicVars.Gold.IntValue, Owner.Gold)` then `PlayerCmd.LoseGold(num, Owner)`, and cards/debt.py implements it against the same four-term in-combat ledger SealOfGold.cs:27 reads -- `player_gold + gold_gained - gold_stolen - gold_spent`, which RunState.finish_combat settles. The loss type is the default (voluntary, not Stolen), so it lands on `gold_spent` and leaves `gold_stolen` meaning Thievery. The port's stated premise, 'The sim has no gold', was FALSE -- bug class 12: RunState.gold exists, RunState.lose_gold is implemented with the matching floor-at-zero semantics and a PlayerCmd.LoseGold citation, and ported content spends gold routinely. EXECUTED: 55 gold in the ledger -> 10 spent; 3 gold -> 3 spent (the Mathf.Min floor); 25 won this combat with nothing banked -> 10 spent, i.e. the balance really is live; and the whole loss reaches the run through finish_combat (55 -> 45). Rule 1: 'the sim does not model it' is a gap, never a waiver, and here the resource was modelled all along. Pinned by test/test_card_residue_gaps2.py (5 tests). NOT CLOSED: nothing at this site.  The text it replaced read: `Mathf.Min(DynamicVars.Gold.IntValue, Owner.Gold)` then `PlayerCmd.LoseGold(num, Owner)` (Debt.cs:26-30) is simply absent from the sim. The sim's own docstring (debt.py:20-21) justifies it with "The sim has no gold" -- THAT CLAIM IS FALSE. `RunState.gold` exists and `RunState.lose_gold` is implemented with the matching floor-at-zero semantics and a `PlayerCmd.LoseGold` citation (run.py:518-520 (RunState.lose_gold, re-verified 2026-08-04 -- moved, not changed)); ported content spends and loses gold routinely (e.g. events/welcome_to_wongos.py buys with `lose_gold`). So Debt is a strictly weaker curse in the sim: in the game, holding it at end of turn costs up to 10 gold per turn, which compounds across a combat and changes what the player can afford at the next shop. LIVE -- Debt is a ported curse and gold is a ported, spendable resource. Note this is a rule-1 case: "the sim does not model it" is a dormant-or-live GAP, never a waiver, and here the resource IS modelled so it is live. RATIONALE CITED A THIRD FILE (rule 7): sts2_rl/run.py was not hashed by this record at the time -- CLOSED 2026-08-04, sts2_rl/run.py and sts2_rl/combat.py are now both in extra_sources, and src/Core/Models/Relics/SealOfGold.cs (the game-side citation backing the ledger claim) is now hashed too.

ctor.issue: Closed 2026-07-30 (tier-2 campaign): `Card.energy_cost` (`sts2_rl/cards/base.py`) now short-circuits on `self._energy_cost < 0` as its first check, returning the raw canonical value before consulting `_free_this_turn` / `_cost_this_turn` / `_cost_this_combat` / `_cost_delta_this_turn` -- mirrors `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers`'s `if (_base < 0) return num;` short-circuit (`CardEnergyCost.cs:101-104`; the record's `:100-103` cite is one line of decompiler drift), which runs before any local or global modifier. All 29 unplayable curse/status/quest cards now set `self._energy_cost = -1` in `_init_vars` (previously 0), each verified individually against its own C# `base(-1, CardType.X, ...)` constructor -- no exceptions, no ascension-gated cost variant. Readers audit (every non-cards/ `energy_cost` hit read in context): combat play/auto-play/valid_actions/action-mask sites gate on `is_playable` first and never see -1; every global-modifier site routes through `hooks.modify_card_energy_cost`, whose dispatcher ends `return max(0, cost)` -- the sim's analogue of C#'s `Math.Max(0, GetWithModifiers(...))` in `GetAmountToSpend`/`GetResolved` (`CardEnergyCost.cs:134-141`) -- so what is SPENT and what the observation encoder reads (`full_env.py` card_features via `previews.py` preview_card_energy_cost) are byte-for-byte unchanged. The three previously-known readers (`relics/mummified_hand.py`, `potions.py` TouchOfInsanity, `cards/event_cards.py` Enlightenment) remain correct, confirmed by unit tests. NOT closed here: `selectors.py`'s `scripted_card_selector` 'to_draw_top' purpose (Headbutt/Thinking Ahead) ranks by raw `card.energy_cost` unclamped -- a sim-only heuristic with no C# analogue; a curse in a Headbutt-eligible discard pile now ranks below-cost instead of tying at 0. No test exercises it; filed in GAP-QUEUE.md's 'Named work with no entry of its own'. New pins: test/test_unplayable_cost.py (15 tests).  The text it replaced read: CURSE / CURSE / NONE map exactly. The canonical energy cost is -1 in C# and 0 in the sim. `CardEnergyCost.GetWithModifiers` returns early on `_base < 0` (CardEnergyCost.cs:100-103), so the game's unplayable card is immune to every cost modifier and keeps reporting -1; the sim runs a base of 0 through the full modifier chain (cards/base.py:422-443 (short-circuit itself now at 433-434), re-verified 2026-08-04 -- moved, not changed). `GetAmountToSpend()` clamps to Math.Max(0, ...) on both sides, so only what is READ diverges. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/ascenders_bane's ctor entry (rule 3). DORMANT: the ported cost readers all filter `> 0` or skip `<= 1` (relics/mummified_hand.py:25, potions.py:228 (TouchOfInsanity, re-verified 2026-08-04 -- was mis-cited by line drift, now the actual `c.energy_cost > 0` filter), cards/event_cards.py:335 (re-verified 2026-08-04 -- the actual `if card.energy_cost <= 1` line; :328 now resolves to an unrelated attribute)), and events/infested_automaton.py:35 filters pool_card_ids(), which holds no curses or statuses.

CanonicalVars.issue: Closed 2026-07-30 (tier-2 campaign): (Task 24.) All 23 cards now store their printed C# var under a `_`-attribute (or, for 3 cards whose C# var is a live/computed value at display time -- guilty, normality, expect_a_fight -- a `magic_number` property override; wither similarly overrides `base_damage`) so `Card.base_damage`/`base_block`/`base_hp_loss`/`magic_number` report the C# value instead of the 0/None default. Two additive base.py changes: `_frail` added to `_MAGIC_ATTRS` (shame) and a new `base_gold` property (debt, spoils_map -- GoldVar had no base property at all). feel_no_pain's `_block` was renamed to `_power_amount` (fixing a WRONG value, not just a missing one -- `base_block` no longer misreports it as block-granting; matches Rage/Corruption/Stampede's DynamicVar('Power', ...) convention). Combat behavior / dealt numbers are byte-identical in every case -- a printed-number / observation-encoder fix only. 3 of the 23 (debt, spoils_map, rolling_boulder's secondary IncrementAmount) have NO obs-vector change despite the API fix (full_env.py has no base_gold read site; magic_number carries one number per card and _power_amount dominates rolling_boulder's scan) -- documented, not closed further. CHECKPOINT NOTE for training: encoded VALUES changed for the other 20 cards in feature slots f[17]/f[18] damage, f[20]/f[21] block, f[22] hp_loss, f[23] magic_number; obs LAYOUT unchanged. Pins: test/test_printed_vars.py (48 tests).  The text it replaced read: `new GoldVar(10)` (Debt.cs:17) has no sim counterpart at all, which follows from the missing OnTurnEndInHand. Recorded separately because the number is also the card's printed value: `magic_number` returns None and the observation encoder sees no secondary number for Debt. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/bad_luck's CanonicalVars entry (rule 3): a printed DynamicVar with no `_`-attribute in `_init_vars`, so the sim's printed-number API reports the default and `full_env.card_features` (full_env.py:700-737, re-verified 2026-08-04 -- moved, not changed) encodes the card wrongly for the policy. DORMANT for game fidelity (the dealt/applied number is identical), LIVE for the observation encoder.
